name: Eternity
source:
Sanae Kochiya is a human who no longer ages. She has difficulty coming to grips with the fact that she may now live forever. She asks Sakuya Izayoi, another human who doesn't age, why she chooses to live an eternal life despite all the ramifications it may bring.

[from [url=https://shrooby.itch.io/eternity]itch.io[/url]]
